{{Top|leg}}
'''Mos Tommro''' was the primary [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] on the planet [[Cilpar]]. It contained [[Docking Bay 66]] and [[Bay 68]]. [[Bothan/Legends|Bothans]] avoided its use.
